title: The Olivewood Hearth Cafe
desc: Tucked within the heart of Lunar Grove, The Olivewood Hearth Café is a quiet refuge shaped by warm timber, glowing embers, and the enduring grace of the olive branch. Here, peace is not merely offered — it is held. The cafe is built upon the enduring olive and the guiding hand — a living symbol of peace shaped by devotion, protection, and choice. Here, all who enter are welcomed into a circle of respect, connection, and calm, where community is nurtured, and hearts are tended.

title: Her Bean Cafe
desc: Her Bean Cafe is a new LGBTQ+2 friendly cafe. Open to all with PG furniture inside, outside, and around the back. Foods and drinks are edibles.

title: Little Pawprints Cat Cafe
desc: A quaint little cafe with cute cats to keep you company. A nice barista will serve you a hot drink, food, or desserts anytime you ask. Come and bring your friends and enjoy the serene and romantic atmosphere.

title: Ruby's Cafe
desc: Ruby's Cafe is the perfect place for people who want to just relax and unwind. Come on by and enjoy good times, friendly people, a cute atmosphere, and of course all the tea and coffee you want! All are welcome.

title: The Moochie Rolling Room
desc: The Moochie Rolling Room is a cozy 420-friendly hangout serving fresh coffee, cakes, and sweet treats alongside custom weed strains, joints, blunts, edibles, and more. Shop, smoke freely, grab a coffee, satisfy the munchies, and sink into a chair. Good weed. Good coffee. Better conversation.

title: SAKURA LIBRARY GARDEN
desc: Escape into a world where stories bloom and minds meet. Whether you're diving into a new novel or hosting a lively book club in these cozy reading nooks, every visit is a celebration of curiosity and community. Come for the books, stay for the friendships.

title: Tarot Café
desc: Sip on virtual elixirs and savor the flavor of delightful snacks as you explore the depths of your consciousness. This Tarot Cafe, at FT Design & Wedding venues, is a space for kindred spirits to connect. Forge new friendships, share experiences, and revel in the magic of the world. Join them near the protected waters — where the virtual meets the mystical, and every hangout becomes a magical journey.

title: Beau Belle
desc: "Follow Your Dreams" at Beau Belle, a thriving community since 2008, modeled on an English coastal village. The region is known for its live music scene and parties at Belle's Coffee Shop and is home to the international Leonard Cohen Club and the Tower Art Gallery, which has new mixed media exhibits each month.

title: Wandering Clouds Cafe
desc: A lovely getaway located on top of a foggy hill. Everyone is welcome to visit, relax and make friends while enjoying the drinks and sweets!

title: Splash Park and Cafe
desc: A vibrant, newcomer, and family-friendly destination designed for relaxation, socializing, dancing, playful fun, and games. Enjoy casual dining: breakfast, coffee, and desserts. Shop for adult furniture and accessories, men's and women's apparel and costumes, thrift store bargains, fine art, and gesture packs. Splash Park & Cafe combines recreation, relaxation, and social interaction into a laid-back getaway.

title: Emily's Cute Coffee Corner
desc: Emily’s Cute Coffee Corner is a cosy little harbour café with a unique twist: by day it’s a warm, welcoming hangout for chatting, meeting new people, and relaxed co-working — and by night it transforms into a lively party spot with music, dancing, and pop-up events. Tucked beside the docks, the setting blends seaside charm with a slightly abandoned, cinematic vibe that somehow feels instantly homey. Whether you come for a quiet coffee moment or an energetic night out, everyone is welcome. Keep an eye out for the regular Thursday events at 11 AM SLT, plus spontaneous surprises.

title: Fat Paws Paradise
desc: Fat Paws Paradise is a cartoon-style playground for Dinkies and small avatars! Climb a giant cat tree, relax at the cafe, or experience farming life. Fully supports MyStory RP & BRDMRT fishing.

title: The Palm & Quill
desc: Welcome to The Palm & Quill, a magical coastal hideaway tucked along Solstice Shore, where the coffee is cozy, the ocean views are dreamy, and there’s always a little corner waiting for you. Come wander through the café, settle in for co-working, lounge by the pool, gather around the bonfire under the stars, or slip down to the beach when you need a softer kind of escape. Whether you’re here to work, socialize, daydream, people-watch, or simply exist beautifully by the sea, The Palm & Quill is open for you.

title: Lee Apothecary
desc: Lee Apothecary is a cozy neighborhood apothecary in Harmony Hills, offering handcrafted teas, herbs, botanical blends, and little moments of calm.

title: Sonder Books
desc: Welcome to Sonder Books, your cozy nook for all things literary. Discover interactive books, learn about Silent Book Club meet-ups in SL, discover talented SL authors, and simply relax in a warm, inviting atmosphere.

title: The Coffee Shop
desc: The Coffee Shop is a voice-friendly, cozy little coffee shop in Shark County, Morgantown. It's perfect for a date, hanging out with friends, or meeting new people. They offer free coffee and tabletop games.

title: Les Bean Coffeehouse
desc: Welcome to Les Bean Coffeehouse, a cozy lakeside haven celebrating love and diversity. Proudly woman-centered and LGBTQIA+ friendly, they offer a safe space to connect, relax, and enjoy their signature blends and baked goods. Whether with friends, working on a project, or savoring a quiet moment, Les Bean Coffeehouse is your destination for great coffee and genuine community. Come as you are and be part of this vibrant, supportive environment.

title: Awen City
desc: Welcome to magical Awen City, a power center for awakened light beings who embody the New Paradigm to connect and explore high-frequency realities and potentials in JoyLightLove.

title: NovaOwl
desc: NovaOwl is an international community and destination on the mainland continent of Corsica located on Novatron. It is a hangout and meeting place with regularly scheduled events. There is a cafe, fishing contests, boat rezzing areas, and an Art Gallery on a waterfront location.

title: Klar Wellness, Second Norway
desc: Klar Wellness is a sanctuary of pure intention, set within the quiet landscapes of Second Norway. Designed around the Nordic philosophy of ro...deep, unhurried peace, and every surface, sound, and silence here has been considered.

title: Unbridled Coffee Shop
desc: Nestled on Evergarden's charming Mane Street, Unbridled is a cozy, equestrian-themed coffee shop where rustic charm meets modern comfort. Sip on locally roasted blends surrounded by horse-inspired decor, tack-lined walls, and warm barnwood accents. Whether you're a rider fresh from the stables or just trotting through town, this is the perfect spot to rein in your day.

title: NO DUMPIRE
desc: NO DUMPIRE is a junktopian hangout with multiple venues for curating eclectic, chill vibes for a community of offbeat, creative, hippie, stoner, bohemian, beatnik, oddball, eccentric, misfit, nerd, geek, freak, and weirdo folks in Second Life. They are lgbtq friendly, 420 friendly, and coffee friendly. Stop by for a visit and chill with them.

title: The Grind Gaming Cafe
desc: The Grind is a gaming cafe where you can chat, relax, play games, and enjoy a cup of coffee in a fun, cozy atmosphere. It is an adult hangout that is LGBTQ+ and furry-friendly. Bring your friends and make new ones!

title: Maison De La Chouette
desc: Welcome to Maison de la Chouette Winery - where wine, art, and relaxation unite! Nestled in the NovaOwl area, Maison de la Chouette stands as the newest gem in Corsica South Coasters. Their commitment to quality starts with using only the finest local grapes, which are lovingly and traditionally smashed by foot to create their exceptional wines. Stepping into the tasting rooms, you'll find yourself immersed in the artistic spirit of Corsica South Coasters. Every two months, they proudly host a resident local artist, showcasing their incredible talent and adding an enriching cultural dimension to your visit.

title: Keyano Haze House
desc: Keyano Haze House is an urban neon chill lounge open to the public. Relax, hang out, meet people, and enjoy a colorful 420-friendly vibe.

title: The Cornbread Cafe
desc: Relax by the fire or enjoy lively chat in one of the coziest cafes in-world, inspired by Caffe Pergolesi. Every Tuesday night (SLT), join a bustling coffee klatch with some of SL's most colorful characters, hosted by Cinnamon and Mongrel. They are open 24 hours, so drop by anytime, grab some java from the espresso machine, and then wander the village, gardens, forest, falls, and lake of Ash Grove.

title: Le'eaf Forest Retreat
desc: In the heart of a timeless forest, the Le'eaf Forest Retreat stands where raindrops compose a symphony upon emerald leaves. Once a bustling train depot, it’s now a cozy café reclaimed by Mother Nature. Vines weave through weathered beams, crafting a tranquil sanctuary. Step inside, escape the ceaseless rain, and find solace where nature and nostalgia blend seamlessly. https://tinyurl.com/leafbean

title: The Dancing Rabbit Cafe
desc: Welcome to the Dancing Rabbit Cafe, a cozy little hideaway where autumn seems to linger just a bit longer. Wander beneath golden leaves and discover a charming spot to enjoy a warm drink, catch up with friends, curl up with a good book, or get a little work done. The resident rabbits hop among the falling leaves, happy to accept a treat from visitors. Whether you're here for good company, a quiet moment, or simply a change of scenery, The Dancing Rabbit is a lovely place to pause and enjoy the season.

title: Commune Utopia
desc: Established in 2011, Commune Utopia is a vibrant, inclusive hippie community set in a natural landscape. Come experience art, music, peace, and freedom. Whether you're looking to meet new friends or hoping for some time for quiet reflection, rest assured you can be who you want to be at Commune Utopia!

title: Solstice Blessing Coffee Lounge
desc: Welcome to The Solstice Blessing Coffee Lounge at Wytchwynds!  Enjoy a break from the rush of the virtual world, surrounded by the sounds of the sea and birdsong, perched on a cliff edge overlooking a moody ocean.

title: A Space Between
desc: A Space Between is a coastal hangout featuring a beach, shipwreck, floating islands, an underwater theater, games, a drum circle, and cuddle spaces. Visitors can explore, socialize, or relax throughout the destination.

title: Tsubomi Cafe
desc: Tsubomi is a scenic flower café nestled in the forest, surrounded by blooms, wildlife, and a peaceful waterfall. Enjoy delicious food, yummy brunch, relaxing walks, shopping, family fun, and a nearby campsite. It's a charming little escape where every visit feels like a new adventure.

title: The Listening Loft
desc: The Listening Loft is a quiet, atmospheric music space built for slowing down and feeling music again, without the pressure of a dancefloor. Each event features one specific artist, with a curated playlist designed to let their world unfold and maybe introduce you to someone new. Settle in alone or with a friend, choose from over 100 cozy places to sit, cuddle, relax, and absorb the music.

title: Amore's Cafe
desc: Amore’s Cafe is a casual hangout spot with coffee, trivia, arcade collectibles, and interactive games. Visitors can fish with 7Seas, explore breedables like KittyCats and Meeroos, or relax in the garden areas with friends.

title: Sakura Maid Cafe
desc: When you step into Sakura Maid Cafe, you will feel like you're at home! Immerse yourself in a world of kawaii charm, where every corner is pink, cozy, and irresistibly cute. This cafe is an authentic Japanese maid cafe and is unlike any other within Kiyori, as it is decorated in a kawaii, pink, very, very cute atmosphere! Enjoy J-POP and live music shows when they are on schedule.

title: Tsidel's Cafe & Ginny's Arcade
desc: Love a good boardwalk arcade, followed by a cup of virtual coffee and maybe a table game? This destination has it all! Stop by Tsidel's cafe for the coffee on your way over to Ginny's Arcade. See you there.

title: Lichen & Lark Coffeehouse
desc: Lichen and Lark Coffeehouse is a serene, moss-kissed hideaway for coffee and calm, where woodland charm, soft ambiance, and good company gather like larks at dawn.

title: Rainy Cafe at Still Waters
desc: Rainy Cafe at Still Waters is a seasonal cafe. It's a place to pause and breathe. Sit. Sip. Stay a while.

title: Coastal Pepper Co.
desc: Welcome to Coastal Pepper Co., a low-key, good vibes-only hangout and venue in the Carolina parcel on mainland. Coastal Pepper's goal is to be a fun, minimally dramatic, safe space to hang out, chat, listen to music, or just generally relax. Coastal Pepper is accessible via Linden waterways, with room for small craft to park temporarily. Visit and hang out for friendly chatter and good times.

title: The Inkwell: A Book Shop
desc: Browse published books written by New Babbage authors. Touch any framed cover on the walls for book details. Play with the shop cats! Relax with a drink and a MadPea game in Inky's Place just next door. Ceejay Writer is the shopkeeper and an author.

title: Epic Gacha Museum
desc: The Epic Gacha Museum boasts an impressive array of gachas, both old and new. It's a must-visit for any gacha enthusiast, as well as a great way to spend an hour or two. There is a coffee shop on site where you can relax, and if you are feeling adventurous, you can explore the whole region full of gachas.

title: The Greenwitch Cafe - Harvest
desc: Warm slices of pumpkin pie, baked apple treats, and mulled cider, all grown and gathered right on-site in this garden-to-table, queer-owned, cannabis-friendly retreat in the Lake District. A cozy space wrapped in autumn color, made for lingering.

title: Oasis Cafe and Park
desc: The oasis cafe offers a space of tranquility and relaxation amongst nature. Get away from it all and come and enjoy the coffee and cakes, or try your hand and some outdoor painting or yoga. All are welcome, whether you need a little peaceful alone time or a cosy place to chat with friends.

title: La Saucisserie
desc: La Saucisserie is where fine art and haute cuisine collide, in a cosy, sausage themed cafe built by renowned DJ Kanjena, in celebration of friendship, music, food, and the many wonders of Second Life creativity.

title: Nana Land
desc: Nana Land is a scenic nature retreat for photography, romantic dancing, exploring, shopping, and quiet moments with friends or someone special. Visitors can wander landscaped paths, relax among the gardens, and discover plenty of photogenic spots throughout the region.

title: The Reading Room
desc: Established in 2015, The Reading Room is a love letter to SL books, readers, and authors. They feature a delightful collection of virtual books, in a variety of formats, that were created for SL and meant to be enjoyed inworld. Help yourself to a cup of something soothing and while away an hour or two in this peaceful, inclusive space. All are welcome.

title: The Pen
desc: Hey all you cats and kittens, focus your audio on this: The Pen, Bay City's only beatnik hang-out, is open! Grab a cup of java juice and jungle on up in this funky shack. Listen to beat greats and hang out awhile. They're no red onion, they've got it all going on. Point that lead sled to Bay City - Mashpee and sail on by. You can't miss it.

title: The Inbetween
desc: The Inbetween is a coffee, art, and community space in the heart of the CSC Mainland Community. Part gallery, part café, part gathering place, it features changing art, coffee, conversation, and events. Stay a while or wander on, with direct access to the Monte Corse hiking trail and Circuit la Corse, one of the continent’s main roads.

title: Stillwater Coast
desc: A Scandinavian-inspired getaway where nature prevails and seagulls call. Listen to the waves hitting the rocks, grab a coffee at the Boathouse Café, and find cozy spots to relax along the beach.

title: Cloud 9 Vibrations
desc: Cloud 9 Vibrations is a welcoming hangout in the Mainland Snowlands where visitors can relax, socialize, and be themselves. Featuring voice chat, an open DJ booth, games, a Zen garden, the Cloud 9 Arena, and private areas to unwind, it offers something for everyone in an LGBTQ+ friendly atmosphere.

title: Adamston - Seogyeo's Market Town
desc: Adamston is part of the larger community of Seogyeoshire, a semi-rural destination with towns, villages, and countryside to explore. Visit restaurants, cafes, bars, a farmer's market, an art gallery, unique shops, the Inclusive Light Synagogue (Reform), and enjoy a scenic journey aboard the Zany Zen Railroad. Nearby, discover gardens, a lake, Adamston Tower, and a small hamlet.

title: The Enchanted Cauldron Cafe
desc: A magical cafe with warm and cold drinks, fresh pastries, and comfy seating. Relax by the fireplace, hang out with friends, or work and study in quiet corners. Soft lighting, warm decor, and a subtle touch of magic create a peaceful escape.

title: The Java Bean
desc: The Java Bean is a cozy little coffee shop and cafe where you can meet good folks and make new friends.

title: Cajun Cup Coffee House
desc: Have you read a good book and are dying to talk about it? Are you looking for a good recommendation for your next read? Join Zaida Gearbox on Sundays at 2 SLT for Coffee & Chat at the Cajun Cup Coffee House in historic New Toulouse.

title: Black Coffee: Cafe & Art
desc: Black Coffee: Cafe & Art offers a cozy space to relax, meet friends, enjoy art, or host private gatherings. With a café, gallery, park, rez zone, and nearby rest house, it’s a welcoming spot for conversation, voice chats, and community events.

title: The Cat's Tale Cafe
desc: The Cat's Tale Cafe is a cozy destination for science fiction fans, featuring weekly story readings on Wednesdays at 8pm and 9pm SLT, Thursdays at 8PM SLT, and discussions on Saturdays at 1pm SLT. Enjoy books, anime, and themed events over coffee or tea. Hosted by Finn Zeddmore, who has been sharing stories here for years. All are welcome.

title: The Hillside Cafe
desc: Welcome to the Hillside Café, a charming and inviting venue in the heart of Morgantown, Heterocera. Whether you're looking for a cozy spot to relax, meet new people, or enjoy great conversations, this café is the perfect place to unwind. Visit for a laid-back social experience, listen to fantastic music, chat on voice, or simply enjoy the warm, welcoming atmosphere.

title: Disability Mystics Nexus
desc: The Disability Mystics Nexus is a diverse and supportive collective of individuals who identify with the disabled community and share a common interest in exploring mysticism, spirituality, and personal growth. Inworld, it is a cozy den with space to chat, study, meet with mentors and/or clients. They host movie nights, discussions, and workshops. They also have a discord for connection.

title: Lofi Cozy Cafe
desc: Lofi Cozy Cafe is a welcoming space to meet new friends, relax on voice, and explore together. Cuddle up, go AFK, or simply vibe while listening to the lofi music stream. Now featuring new hot springs for ultimate chill and comfort.

title: Stand Up! Comedy
desc: STAND UP! COMEDY is a hangout that brings you a 24/7 comedy stream for your entertainment. Come hang out, meet people, play Greedy, Skippo, Hand & Foot, and more. Socialize and most of all, laugh! All are welcome, however moderate content is being streamed 24/7. 18+ recommended.

title: God Shot Cafe
desc: God Shot Cafe is a modern, upscale cafe on the beach in Gaenari, Jeogeot continent. One of the anchor locations for the CoffeeSluts of Second Life group, GSC is the place to come for sophisticated conversation and an awesome music stream.

title: Photo Cafe
desc: Photo Cafe' is a meeting place for all SL Photographers (at any level) to gather and share experiences, hints, tips, and tricks, landmarks or contests (inworld or on socials), and whatever else comes to mind! They hold moderated discussions, events, and exclusive or retrospective exhibits. Learn more at www.photocafe.news

title: The Waterfall Cafe
desc: Indulge in delightful dining amidst vibrant colors, cascading waterfalls, and a legendary Kraken Bar. Discover romance in the underwater observatory, surrounded by mesmerizing marine life. It's a sanctuary of beauty, serenity, and unforgettable moments. Dive into this extraordinary world and be immersed in enchantment at the Waterfall Cafe.

title: Little Whiskeria
desc: Welcome to Little Whiskeria! Enjoy whiskey, whiskers, and cozy vibes in this CSC Mainland Community. Settle in with a whiskey, enjoy the company of cuddly cats, explore nature, or find a cozy corner with friends. From quiet moments to occasional live music and parties, Little Whiskeria is all about good company, relaxed vibes, and whiskered charm. Come by and stay a while!

title: Pumpkin Spice Cafe & Cinnamon Park
desc: Take a breather from your hectic day and stop by the Pumpkin Spice Cafe and Cinnamon Park. Have a cappuccino and enjoy conversation with old friends and new, in this clean and modern cafe. Or celebrate nature in green hills teeming with wildlife. Just off Route 9 in Madhupak at the southern end of the Chilbo community!

title: Time Lost Cafe
desc: Time Lost Cafe is a Chicago-based casual and relaxing place where you can relax on your own or talk and dance with friends. You can enjoy the art on permanent display, buy some if you like to take it home with you.

title: The Retreat
desc: The Retreat is a beautiful hang-out with a lush garden, art gallery and the Basement Club. Enjoy, take pictures and bring friends to this wonderful place!

title: Newbank Community Center
desc: Newbank is the public community center for the Newbrooke Linden Homes. Spanning the whole newbank region, this community center has numerous places to congregate with friends, grab some delicious treats to eat, or sit and relax to the sounds of birds and flowing water.

title: Java Sprockets
desc: Grab a cup of fresh coffee or a bite to eat at Java Sprockets, a beachside coffee shop. Out front is a Rez Zone where you can pick up a free bicycle and enjoy a ride around Bellisseria. Everyone is welcome and everything is free! Java Sprockets is a community area in Bellisseria that offers all a place to hang out and chat.
